gt_flags.translation: Will you connect with me on Instagram?
gt_flags.excerpt: Instagram पे कनेक्ट होगे मेरे साथ?

model_flags.translation: Connect with me on Instagram, yes, I will, but I don't know you yet.
model_flags.excerpt: इंस्टाग्राम पर कनेक्ट हो गए मेरे साथ हाँ हो जाऊँगी बट मैं आपको जानती नहीं हूँ ना अभी तो
model_flags.model_context: The user asked where the expert was from, and the expert responded by suggesting connecting on Instagram. The user then agreed to connect but expressed hesitation.

model_flags.translation: Yes, check my profile once, if it seems right, then talk, otherwise block me.
model_flags.excerpt: हाँ एक बार देख लो मेरी प्रोफाइल वहाँ सही लगे तो बात कर लेना वरना ब्लॉक कर देना
model_flags.model_context: Following the suggestion to connect on Instagram, the expert is giving instructions on how the user should proceed after viewing her profile.

model_flags.translation: By the way, I am also on Instagram, I will connect, yes, I will, but I don't know you.
model_flags.excerpt: वैसे मैं मयूर भी है इंस्टाग्राम पर कनेक्ट हो गई हाँ हो जाऊंगी बट मैं आपको जा
model_flags.model_context: The expert is reiterating her presence on Instagram and agreeing to connect, while still stating she doesn't know the user.
